Abstract: In this paper, we consider the Cauchy problem for the generalized Camassa-Holm
equation proposed by Hakkaev and Kirchev (2005) [13]. We prove that the solution map of the
generalized Camassa-Holm equation is not uniformly continuous on the initial data in Besov spaces.
Our result include the present work (2020) [20, 21] on Camassa-Holm equation with Q = 1 and
extends the previous non-uniform continuity in Sobolev spaces (2015) [23] to Besov spaces. In
addition, the non-uniform continuity in critical space B
3
2
2,1(R) is the ﬁrst to be considered in our
paper.
Keywords: Generalized Camassa-Holm equation, Non-uniform continuous dependence, Besov
spaces

When Q = 1, Eq. (1.1) is reduced to the famous Camassa-Holm (CH) equation
ut −uxxt + 3uux = 2uxuxx + uuxxx,
(1.2)
which was ﬁrst found by Fuchssteiner and Fokas [11] and later derived as a water wave model
by Camassa and Holm [2]. The CH equation is completely integrable [2, 6], has bi-Hamiltonian
structure [11, 3], possesses an inﬁnity of conservation laws and admits exact peakon solutions of the
form ce−|x−ct| , describing an essential feature of the travelling waves of largest amplitude [2, 7, 8].
The local well-posedness and ill-posedness for the Cauchy problem of the CH equation (1.2)
in Sobolev spaces and Besov spaces were studied in the series of papers [4, 5, 9, 12, 19]. After
the non-uniform continuity for some dispersive equations was studied by Kenig et al. [17], non-
uniform dependence of the CH equation has been studied by several authors.
The ﬁrst non-
uniform dependence result for CH equation was established by Himonas and Misio lek [14] in Hs
with s ⩾2 on the circle using explicitly constructed travelling wave solutions and this was then
sharpened to s > 3
2 in [15] on the line and [16] on the circle. The above mentioned works utilize
the method of approximate solutions in conjunction with delicate commutator and multiplier
estimates. Danchin[9, 10] showed the local existence and uniqueness of strong solutions to (1.2)
with the initial data in Bs
p,r for s > max{1 + 1
p, 3
2}, 1 ≤p ≤∞, 1 ≤r < ∞. The continuous
properties of the solutions on the initial data have been supplemented by Li and Yin in [19]. Very
recently, Li, Yu and Zhu [20] have sharpened the results in [19] by showing that the solution map
is not uniformly continuous, which depends deeply on the estimates of the transfer equation in
Besov space and the constructed high-low frequency smooth initial data.

Abstract: In this paper, we consider the Cauchy problem for the generalized Camassa-Holm equation proposed by Hakkaev and Kirchev (2005) [13]. We prove that the solution map of the generalized Camassa-Holm equation is not uniformly continuous on the initial data in Besov spaces. Our result include the present work (2020) [20, 21] on Camassa-Holm equation with Q = 1 and extends the previous non-uniform continuity in Sobolev spaces (2015) [23] to Besov spaces. In addition, the non-uniform continuity in critical space B 3 2 2,1(R) is the ﬁrst to be considered in our paper.
